method_note: Vacancy count and deficiency flags are arithmetic on the club's own published chart (how many names the club lists at that position). They are not an opinion about player quality, and no quality grade is available from an official source in this repository.

flags.finding: LCB lists exactly one player (Renardo Green) and that player was a DNP on the latest official report; the chart provides no listed backup at that position.
flags.consequence: Any replacement at left corner is, on the club's own chart, a player the club did not list as depth at that position - the 'second stringer' the brief asks the system to detect is absent, not merely inferior.
flags.action: Flag as a measurable availability condition; do not attach a quality penalty number, which we cannot source.

flags.finding: Both listed cornerbacks on the LCB and RCB lines (Green, Lenoir) were DNPs on the same report, while the nickel (Stout) was limited.
flags.consequence: Three of the chart's four listed corner bodies were not full participants, so the coverage availability state is a package-level change, not a single-player change.
flags.action: Availability model must operate at the position-group level as well as the player level (R-04 acceptance criterion).

flags.finding: RG, RT, FB, NB, P, K, H, LS each list one player; LG, C, RDT, RDE, SAM, MIKE, WILL, RCB, FS list two.
flags.consequence: A 'vacancy' is normal for these positions, so a raw count of names cannot be treated as a deficiency signal without a league-wide baseline; several of these are single-slot roles by construction.
flags.action: Deficiency index must be relative to the league distribution of listed depth at that position, which requires all 32 charts (SG-10) before any threshold is set.

flags.finding: Two players on the Week 10 report (Nate Hobbs, C.J. West) do not appear on the fetched depth chart at all.
flags.consequence: The report and the chart are different documents with different populations; a signal that reads only the chart misses availability-relevant players, and one that reads only the report misses depth order.
flags.action: Join on player identity, keep 'in report but not on chart' and 'on chart but not in report' as explicit states, and never impute either.

flags.finding: The chart is dated by the club ('Updated as of 11/10/26') and the report is a Friday practice report; neither is a lineup.
flags.consequence: Anything this section says about who starts is conditional and must be labelled as-of the document it came from.
flags.action: Every derived row carries both dates in its source link text; final lineups are not published by these sources at all.
